title: Credit limit choices
decision: A limit is between 1 000 and 10 000 000 000 UZS; all staff may read the credit settings; the code LIMIT_REACHED means the credit limit and the manual reminder limit is REMINDER_LIMIT_REACHED; the limit is not shown to the customer
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 30
rationale: A seller must see the limit to understand a refusal; a customer shown a limit would read it as a promise
